spec: Implement the user-supplied requirements at https://github.com/contoso/outdoor-store/issues/27. Source revision: 2026-09-14T08:40:00Z. Task acceptance criteria below map that scope to specialist-owned work.

tasks.title: Share the cart session value between both apps
tasks.body:
Move the cart to `src/Contoso.Outdoor.Domain` as a JSON-serialisable type and register its session key with the System.Web adapters' JSON session serializer in both the legacy app and the new host.

## Acceptance criteria
- A cart written by the legacy app reads back identically in the new host, and the other way round.
- The legacy cart pages behave as before.
- No second session store is added.

tasks.title: Look up current prices for cart lines
tasks.body:
Add a query in `src/Contoso.Outdoor.Data.Core` that loads the current prices of the products in a cart for PriceCalculator.

## Acceptance criteria
- Returns the same prices as the EF6 context for the same products.
- Products that no longer exist are left out, as the legacy cart does.
- No migration is added.

tasks.title: Port the cart routes
tasks.body:
Port CartController (`Index` and `Add`) and its view to the new host using the remote session; YARP stops forwarding the cart routes.

## Acceptance criteria
- `/Cart` and `/Cart/Add` keep their URLs, redirects, anti-forgery validation and totals.
- A cart started on a legacy page shows the same lines on the new host.
- Checkout and account routes are still forwarded.
